reference_action: OP switched from fast-drying terracotta to plastic and added a small mound of soil; plant perked up. Confirmed container/soil change improves moisture retention. More water was suggested but not explicitly reported as the adopted change.

sources.reason: No plastic container or soil-retention change; focuses on fast drainage and other causes.
Diagnoses dry versus wet root zone and deep-waters when dry, but does not retrieve the OP-confirmed plastic-plus-added-soil change.
Terracotta/gritty mix and bone-dry root claim oppose confirmed retention fix.
Ground planting, withholding water and hard cutback do not retrieve plastic pot/added soil.
Some recognize prior drying, but actual advice is discard, prune or leave alone; no successful container change.

actions.action: Provide 4+ hours direct light or 12-hour grow light
Move away from heat and improve air movement
Feed diluted organic fertilizer every 6–8 weeks
Check pH and add lime/bone/oyster meal if acidic
Acclimate indoor/outdoor moves over a week
Move to summer afternoon shade in hot subtropical conditions

resolved.reason: Overwatering-first differential omits actual rapid substrate drying and container solution. Soil check and heat protection reduce immediate harm, but many unsupported extra treatments and unspecified doses make this an inaccurate, burdensome answer.

harmfulness.reason: “Water only when the top 2 in ... are completely dry” is a safeguard against automatic withholding. Weekly neem and repeated fertilizer/flush/lime suggestions lack adequate diagnosis and dosing, creating avoidable risks for a stressed plant.

specificity_accuracy.reason: The video presents six generic reasons, led by overwatering, without identifying the moisture-retention problem or recommending plastic. Heat avoidance has some relevance but does not recover the confirmed solution.

feasibility.reason: Light duration, watering depth and acclimation period are measurable. Many simultaneous tasks, vague humidity control and unspecified neem/fertilizer strengths make the overall routine difficult to apply reliably.
